description: Source code implementing the U-Plane message decoder for Open Fronthaul messages, including header parsing, section decoding, and IQ data decompression.

classes.name: uplane_message_decoder_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the U-Plane message decoder, handling header parsing, section decoding, and IQ data decompression.

classes.name: uplane_peeker
classes.description: Utility class for peeking at filter index and slot/symbol information from raw message bytes.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a U-Plane message, parsing header and all sections.

methods.name: decode_header
methods.description: Parses the header of the U-Plane message, extracting direction, version, filter index, slot, and symbol info.

methods.name: decode_all_sections
methods.description: Decodes all sections within the message until no bytes remain or an error occurs.

methods.name: decode_section
methods.description: Decodes a single section, including header, compression info, and IQ data.

methods.name: decode_section_header
methods.description: Parses the section header to extract section ID, PRB info, and flags.

methods.name: decode_compression_length
methods.description: Reads the compression length if applicable based on compression type.

methods.name: decode_iq_data
methods.description: Decompresses IQ samples from the message data.
